testcase.name: sanity: the two terms really are SAT-inconsistent together
remove mode drops the violating annotations
downrank mode scales the score and flags evidence
flag mode keeps annotations but marks them
a consistent protein is left untouched
minimal-flip resolves a co-annotation conflict by dropping the lower-weight term
enforcement records provenance actions and trail lines
organism mode removes only the conflicting term, not a consistent co-annotation
